admission.reason: Unresolved Sturgis source overlap; normalized diagnostic is not a v0.29A bundle

coordinateNormalization.limitation: Same-datum NAD83 projection; PROJ reports operation accuracy as unavailable. Native source grid and tolerance are computational metadata, not source boundary accuracy.
coordinateNormalization.operation: Michigan Oblique Mercator (meter) (with axis order normalized for visualization)

effectiveCycleReview.interpretation: 2024 effective cycle inferred from the statewide 2024 layer context and approved township resolution. The raw ELECTIONYE=2023 attribute is preserved. This is not independent boundary certification.

geometryNormalization.policy: Polygonal make_valid only with <=0.00001 square metre area change; snap at native resolution; exclude only shared overlap strips within both source boundary tolerances; retain all larger conflicts.

limitations: Diagnostic only: not an admitted PrecinctDemographicBundle or runtime replacement.
Partial units contain only allocated evidence; null means unavailable, never zero population.
Complete means no unresolved source block touches the unit under this diagnostic; it is not legal-boundary or runtime admission.
Quarantined targets never receive population. Invalid footprints are normalized only to conservatively exclude intersecting blocks.
No split population or housing evidence is available; no area weighting or registered-voter splitting is used.
Whole-block containment precedes in-block Census internal points. Any ambiguous or quarantined intersection is unavailable.
2020 VAP is not 2024 eligibility or citizenship. No individual behavior or candidate preference is inferred.
Bounded ambiguous overlap strips are excluded from both targets; the Sturgis pair remains quarantined. Flint's raw 2023 attribute is preserved with a documented effective-cycle interpretation.

mapAudit.overlapPolicy: all strictly positive polygon intersections quarantine both targets; no area threshold or area weighting
mapAudit.repairPolicy: Versioned native source-tolerance normalization precedes this gate; unresolved conflicts remain quarantined
